partners.diseaseBName: obsolete skeletal muscle glycogen content and metabolism quantitative trait locus
partners.mechanism_chain: ASPSCR1 (HGNC:24351) —LEADS_TO→ Alveolar soft part sarcoma (MONDO:0011655); PRKAG3 (HGNC:9727) —BINDS→ AMPK signaling pathway (WP2341); AMPK signaling pathway (WP2341) —LEADS_TO→ Obsolete skeletal muscle glycogen content and metabolism quantitative trait locus (MONDO:0033571).
